title: Value added tax information
description: Learn how to provide your VAT information on your >x< Ads account if you operate as a business in the EU.

toc.title: How do I enter my VAT information?
Why am I unable to select "Personal" as my tax status?
Region: Rest of the world outside the United States, European Union, and Australia

runs: Most businesses in the European Union are required to register for value-added tax (VAT). The VAT registration number (VAT ID) provides a unique identifier for the collection and submission of VAT to government tax authorities. The specific registration thresholds and sign up processes vary by country.
How do I enter my VAT information?
Click "Account Settings" from the top-right drop-down menu
Fill in the appropriate VAT information (including 2 letter country code) and address
Please note that whether you are charged VAT on your purchases of >x< Ads depends on whether you are purchasing ads for business purposes and what country your business is located in.

As a result of this decision, the "Personal" tax status is disabled. The relevant business person must meet the following criteria to choose the "Business" tax status option.

Definition of relevant business person: a business person who is purchasing >x<’s services to gain economic advantage by promoting goods and services on >x<. A relevant business person is purchasing services other than wholly for private purpose. There is no VAT registration obligation of the relevant business person based on the EU directive, however the relevant business person must meet the criteria mentioned above.
